name: stacked-pancakes
description: Schematic 3D linear section of a rotational hypersurface in R^(n+1), n >= 3; not an R3 mean curvature flow.

revolution.surfaceHelp: Schematic 3D section, not an R3 flow. Drag to rotate; + / − zoom. Revolve to 360° to close the display cutaway. Copper marks the neck; Meridian shows the radius profile.
revolution.meridianHelp: Schematic radius profile: blue upper half, orange reflected lower half. Two radius maxima and one positive neck minimum. Height z is the paper’s axial x coordinate; no flow is numerically solved.
